process notice.followup v1
Subject: case
Stages: [notice]
Start: send
Uses: [rule/notice.reply_state]
Requires: [followup@1]
Variables: [{Name=case_ref, Type=Code, IsInput=true}, {Name=replies, Type=Integer, IsInput=false}]
Windows: [{Name=contact_hours, Zone=America/New_York, Days=[Monday, Tuesday, Wednesday, Thursday, Friday], From=09:00, To=18:00}]
Triggers: [{Event=case.opened, BusinessKeyMember=case_ref, Kind=event, Input=[[case_ref, case_ref]]}, {Id=morning, Cron=0 8 * * 1-5, Zone=America/New_York, Misfire=Skip, Kind=schedule, Input=[]}]
Scenarios: [open window sends at once and the second round finds a reply, a closed window holds the notice until the next opening, the poll expires after the longest allowed time, a zone the host cannot resolve follows onError, a failed read after its retries follows onError]
step send
  Kind: Action
  Stage: notice
  Routes: [{Label=next, Target=await_reply}, {Label=onError, Target=failed}]
  Port: messaging.notice
  Delivery: AtLeastOnce
  IsContact: true
  Window: contact_hours
  Retry: {MaxAttempts=2, Backoff=fixed, Initial=00:05:00}
  Inputs: [{Name=case, Variable=case_ref}]
  InputNames: [case_ref]
step await_reply
  Kind: Poll
  Routes: [{Label=next, Target=done}, {Label=onError, Target=failed}, {Label=onExpired, Target=expired}]
  Port: intake.replies
  Retry: {MaxAttempts=1, Backoff=none, Initial=00:00:00}
  Rule: notice.reply_state
  Poll: {Field=state, Until=[answered], Every=01:00:00, Backoff=exponential, Max=04:00:00, MaxDuration=06:00:00}
  Inputs: [{Name=case, Variable=case_ref}]
  Facts: [{Name=replies, Variable=replies}]
  Outputs: [{Name=reply_count, Variable=replies}]
  InputNames: [case_ref, replies]
  OutputNames: [replies]
step done
  Kind: End
  Result: answered
step expired
  Kind: End
  Result: expired
step failed
  Kind: End
  Result: failed
